contentPattern.structure: question label + answer content per row

suitableFor: any page with a stack of toggleable label/content pairs

notes: Adopted from the vanilla AEM Block Collection accordion. The vanilla source imports moveInstrumentation from scripts/scripts.js; this doc project's scripts.js does NOT export moveInstrumentation, so the import and its usage were removed (consistent with the tabs and carousel-hero blocks in this project). Content model: 2-column table, each row = [question | answer]; decorated into native <details>/<summary> disclosures.
